_comment: New York progressive income tax. 2024 single brackets + standard deduction. MFJ uses single brackets (approx; NY MFJ brackets differ — verify). Excludes NYC/Yonkers local tax. VERIFY vs NY DTF for 2026.
name: New York
notes: New York's income tax runs from 4% to 10.9%. Most full-time salaries land in the 5.5% to 6.85% brackets.
This calculator covers New York State tax only. It doesn't include New York City or Yonkers income tax. If you live in NYC, your real take-home will be lower than shown.
It also leaves out New York's small payroll deductions for State Disability Insurance (SDI) and Paid Family Leave (PFL). Check your pay stub for the exact amounts.
Married filers use single brackets here, so the result is an estimate. Treat it as a close guide, not your exact withholding.
